visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot focuses on a young woman's face. Her skin appears smooth and radiant. A white bottle is tilted above her cheek, dispensing a clear, viscous drop of liquid that slowly glides down her skin. She has long dark hair and subtle makeup. (2) The camera pulls back to a medium close-up. The woman holds the white bottle with a metallic silver cap next to her face, smiling brightly at the camera. The background is a warm, softly lit indoor environment. (3) Close-up on the product label which reads 'Gelovery'. The woman begins applying the liquid to her face, using her fingertips to massage it into her cheeks in a gentle upward motion. (4) A top-down shot of a hand shows the liquid being squeezed onto the palm. Multiple quick cuts show the liquid spreading and being absorbed on the skin of a hand. (5) A series of instructional clips follow, where the woman demonstrates a 7-step application process. She uses her palms to press the product into her cheeks, forehead, chin, nose, eye area, and neck. Her eyes are often closed in a relaxed expression. (6) A split-screen comparison shows two halves of her face; text labels indicate before and after states. The right side appears more hydrated and glowing. (7) A screen recording sequence appears, showing a social media page on Facebook and a professional retail website for the brand. Product listings, prices, and promotional banners are scrolled through. (8) The woman returns to the frame, resting her chin on her hand and smiling contentedly. She touches her cheek to emphasize the texture. (9) The video concludes with a close-up of the bottle followed by a minimalist white screen featuring the gold brand logo.
